summary: Lincoln County, MT lookout: camp in 1915, tree-top platform by 1929, 65' steel Aermotor tower built 1934, gone by 1963; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower and cabin gone by 1963 per firelookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list also marks it as a tower that is gone. No source describes what remains at the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association lists the site as a tower. The 1929 description is of a tent and a tree-top platform, which predates the 1934 steel tower. The tower kind fits the 1934 structure; the platform is an earlier structure at the same site.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: status gone, kind tower (for the 1934 structure), agency Kootenai NF, and coordinates match the association list. The 1934 build date and the 1963 end rest on the firelookout.com page; the association list confirms only that the site is a gone tower. The 1929 quote is from a Forest Lookouts page quoting Archie Murchie's oral history; the oral history itself was not checked. No source describes the summit today or its access, so the access key is omitted. Photo alt text gives the 1953 year; license is not stated. One WebSearch and about four page reads used.
